messages:
sarah_sales: @jordan_acme quick sync — Acme asked for an "assurance packet" for the POC. They want: SOC 2 excerpt, an ISO-style network diagram for staging, a signed pen-test letter (to present to their procurement), and a way for their external scanner to hit staging. They also want a delta on dedicated pricing if we need single-tenant staging. Can we get a runbook of what we can share by EOD tomorrow?

ajay_se: +1. For the scanner we should avoid sharing long-lived keys. Recommend: presigned S3 for artifact upload + a narrow source IP allowlist for the external scan.

ajay_se: Example presign command we can give them: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/acme-poc/scan.zip --expires-in 86400`

maggie_compliance: Heads-up on artifacts: we can provide the SOC 2 report excerpt (cover letter + scope pages) and a redacted control matrix. We cannot provide raw audit logs or internal change-control tickets. The ISO-style diagram is fine if it's high-level and redacted (no hostnames, no internal IPs).

maggie_compliance: Regarding the pen-test letter: we have a standard attestation template that legal needs to sign. It states we allow a one-time external scan in staging with predefined scope and no elevated credentials. We *cannot* sign a statement claiming a clean pen-test result — only that testing was permitted and monitored.

sarah_sales: Important — procurement specifically asked to see a signed pen-test attestation that looks like: "vendor allows independent third-party security assessment; findings will be shared under NDA". Is our template acceptable to them? @jordan_acme can you share a redline if their procurement insists on wording change?

jordan_acme: thx all. procurement said they need the signatory block to include company legal name + city. small ask. they also asked whether scans can be scheduled outside business hours. Ideally before Mar 20.

ajay_se: Scheduling outside business hours is fine. We'll spin a one-off staging container with an IP range and open the scanner window. We should log the window start/end and rotation of any ephemeral creds.

devops-bot: Deploy job started: artifact-proxy/prepare-staging (job id: job-8792). ETA ~45m. Will post staging IP and presign link once ready.

maggie_compliance: For the attestation signature: Legal needs to review the customer's redline. If it's a minor add of legal name + city that's usually OK. Anything that shifts liability or guarantees results will need a cross-org review and will delay by ~5 business days.

sarah_sales: Action items: 1) @ajay_se make presigned upload and ephemeral scan window; 2) @maggie_compliance escalate pen-test template to legal if procurement redlines; 3) @jordan_acme will send the procurement redline by EOD. Also: estimate of pricing bump for single-tenant dedicated staging? ballpark needed for procurement.

ajay_se: Ballpark: small POC with single-tenant reserved pool -> add ~25% monthly over shared burst pricing. If they only need an isolated staging window (short-lived), cost impact is minimal (we can absorb for POC). I'll confirm exact quote with infra ops.

jordan_acme: sending redline now. also prefer evening scan (after 10pm) — ok for you all?

maggie_compliance: evening scan ok. remind client to sign NDA before we hand over findings. Our attestation template references NDA requirement for any detailed findings.

devops-bot: Staging ready: IPs 54.213.11.45/32 (scanner allowlist), presign URL (expires in 24h): https://s3-redwood.example/presign/acme-poc/scan.zip?token=XXX (placeholder).

ajay_se: Posted the quick ops checklist to the thread: 1) confirm NDA, 2) confirm scan scope (hosts + ports), 3) provide presigned upload for results, 4) schedule scan window and rotation of creds.

sarah_sales: thanks team. I'll update AcmeProcurement with the attestation caveats (no guarantees, legal sign-off for redlines) and the pricing ballpark. Will follow up after Jordan posts the redline. :thumbsup:

jordan_acme: redline sent — it's just legal name + city in signatory block. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone.

maggie_compliance: Received. I'll route to legal now and flag as low-risk. Expect sign-off in 24-48h unless they change liability language.

sarah_sales: perfect. closing the loop here — will post final packet + link to presigned artifacts once legal signs.

ajay_se: FYI folks: keep logs of the presign token usage and return the scan results into the evidence bucket; we'll archive the scan report after 30 days.

sarah_sales: locking this into my notes. if any change in scope, ping this thread. :sparkles:
